cases.task: I want to build an AI app for small businesses. Research it and design the app for me. I have not decided who it serves or the first version.

Our approved first version helps freelance designers create and download an invoice. Exclude payments, accounts and reminders. No research, analytics or competitor sources are available, and you have no browsing or participant tools for this task. Do not ask questions or create files. Give me a short provisional product direction and the smallest research plan that could test its main uncertainty. You may propose hypotheses, but do not expand scope.

Review only the strength of this evidence for an existing invoice app; do not design screens or browse. Five interviewees said they could not find Download. Two recordings show participants failing to download an invoice. The analytics export says 52% opened the invoice screen but supplies no event definitions, denominator or date range. Our founder says this proves every customer needs a new dashboard and conversion will improve 30%. Explain what each source establishes and what remains unknown. Do not ask questions.

This is a focused copy correction in our existing invoice app: change the visible button text from Submit to Download invoice. It already downloads the PDF and has an accessible name derived from its text. Preserve all behavior, styles and scope. No interviews or analytics exist. Do not edit files; give only the change and its acceptance check.

Our approved scope is to improve completion of the existing invoice-download flow, with no new features. The only unresolved question is whether freelance designers can find and finish downloading the PDF on mobile. Prepare a lightweight research plan and participant guide. Some participants use screen readers and their own phones. Do not ask me questions, recruit anyone, send messages, record participants or create files. We have an approved consent process but have not run any sessions.

For our existing invoice-download flow, plan research to distinguish why users say Download is easy from why some do not finish the task. You have only three interviews and an analytics report from an older UI version. A competitor claims its redesigned dashboard improved satisfaction, but its study methods are unavailable. No browsing or participant tools are available. Do not ask questions or add features. Tell me the next research step and how you will treat these sources.

Prepare a seven-question participant interview guide about how freelancers currently create invoices and download them. The actor, job and scope are supplied here. No payment questions, recruitment, messages, files or intake questions. Use neutral questions and distinguish reported experiences from observed behavior. No sessions have happened.

We are designing invoice PDF download for freelance designers. Research is unavailable. I approve prototyping the layout, but the required rule for who can download another person's invoice is unknown and I have not delegated that access decision. Proceed with the supported prototype brief, list the unresolved boundary, and tell me whether authorization behavior is ready to implement. Do not ask questions, browse, create files or invent users or roles.
